_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Wa kujoga Golf (Kadi ya Jogo) - Jogadori {player_id}.
Lengo: Kupata alama ya chini kabisa katika duru hii moja. Ikiwa safu wana thamani sawa, wanaongezwa kama 0.
Thamani za Kadi: A=1, 2-10=thamani ya uso, J/Q=10, K=0

Vitendo (tumia mabano kamili):
- '[draw]' - Chora kutoka kadeti
- '[take]' - Twala kutoka kadi zilizokulukwa
- '[swap X Y]' - Badilisha kadi iliyochorwa na nafasi X (safu) Y (safu wima)
- '[discard]' - Bulia kadi iliyochorwa

board.drew:
O wewe usaka: {card}
Sasa wewe fwaya [swap X Y] au [discard] yake.
board.took:
Waboka: {card} ku kipande kya kusola
Kusola [swap X Y] na kipande ki (kisumbi kusola).

options.final_turns: Vuka za mwisho! O vuka kwami: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.draw: O ima i u tena o kubhanga: [draw], [take]
options.must_swap: Eie ua tokala: [swap X Y] (ku katula o ji kalatá ku kialu kia te kalu)
options.swap_or_discard: Eie ua tokala: [swap X Y] mba [discard]

message.deck_empty: O kididi kia kubhânga ki kiala-ku dingi!
message.knocked: Jogadori {pid} kazala kubata! Kila jogador kiakulu kinafwako luzingu lumbakala.
message.final_round: Jogadori {pid} {reason}! Kila jogador kiakukwa kimo vuka.

invalid.wrong_action: Tumia hatua moja iliyo na mabano: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], au [peek X Y]
invalid.discard_empty: Kipande kya kusola ki mwene kalembe!
invalid.must_draw_first: Kewa kufwete kwanza [draw], [take], [knock], kana [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Eie ku tena kueha ngó o kalatá, ua tokala u ka vutuila.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Wewe una kadi iliyochorwa. Wewe fwaya [swap X Y] au [discard] yake.
invalid.need_drawn_swap: Phala ku tambula o kamukanda kaka, eie ua tokala u kala ni mukanda mu dimi diê.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: Phala ku jimba o iluezu, eie ua tokala u kala ni "uhete".
invalid.out_of_bounds: Nafasi nje ya mipaka. Tumia safu 1-{max_row}, safu wima 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Kewa kazala kubata neno kijogo kiakulwako. Kima luzingu lwako kwanza.
invalid.already_knocked: Saí muthu ua nganhala kiá o ita íii.
invalid.already_revealed: O kiteka kiki, a ki tungununa kiá!
